name: IJM Corporation Berhad
overview: 今年 IJM 的业务板块没有出现产能扩张、新业务进入或业务退出的公告；主要业务动态是 Property Development 板块出售一幅位于 Sabah 的 Sandakan 的土地及建筑物，以及 Manufacturing and Quarrying 板块下三家休眠子公司进行成员自愿清盘。此外，公司全年收到 Sunway Berhad 通过 Maybank Investment Bank 提出的有条件自愿全面收购要约，该事项属于公司层面而非业务板块层面。
overview_en: In 2026, IJM's business segments saw no announcements of capacity expansion, entry into new businesses, or business exits; the main business developments were the disposal of a piece of land and building in Sandakan, Sabah by the Property Development segment, and the members' voluntary winding-up of three dormant subsidiaries under the Manufacturing and Quarrying segment.

segments.name: 产业发展
segments.note: 今年该板块出售一幅位于 Sabah 的 Sandakan 的土地及建筑物。
segments.note_en: This segment disposed of a piece of land and building in Sandakan, Sabah this year.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: IJM Properties Sdn Bhd 与 Coupang Sdn Bhd 签订买卖协议，以 4,750 万令吉现金出售位于 Sabah 的 Sandakan、面积约 9,518.4 平方米的土地及一栋带夹层单层建筑物。
actions.text_en: IJM Properties Sdn Bhd entered into a sale and purchase agreement with Coupang Sdn Bhd to dispose of a piece of land measuring about 9,518.4 square metres together with a single-storey building with mezzanine floor in Sandakan, Sabah, for a total cash consider…

segments.name: 制造与采石
segments.note: 今年该板块下三家休眠子公司进行成员自愿清盘。
segments.note_en: Three dormant subsidiaries under this segment underwent members' voluntary winding-up this year.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 三家休眠子公司 Azam Ekuiti Sdn Bhd、Oriental Empire Sdn Bhd 和 Warga Sepakat Sdn Bhd 根据《2016 年公司法》第 439(1)(b) 条进行成员自愿清盘。
actions.text_en: Three dormant subsidiaries, Azam Ekuiti Sdn Bhd, Oriental Empire Sdn Bhd and Warga Sepakat Sdn Bhd, were wound up by way of members' voluntary winding-up pursuant to Section 439(1)(b) of the Companies Act 2016.
